title: Early Closure Charge Settings for Personal Checking
content:
Each Personal Checking tier sets the charge that arises when the owner closes the account inside the early closure window, and the number of calendar days after the opening date over which that window runs.

| Tier | Early closure charge (USD) | Length of the early closure window (calendar days after opening) |
|---|---|---|
| Access Checking | 0.00 | 90 |
| Student Checking | 0.00 | 90 |
| Everyday Checking | 25.00 | 90 |
| Interest Checking | 25.00 | 90 |
| Premier Checking | 25.00 | 90 |
| Private Client Checking | 25.00 | 90 |

The window is 90 calendar days on every tier. A charge of 0.00 means the tier takes nothing for a closure inside that window.

**Basis Q and A.**

*Which tiers carry an early closure charge at all?* Everyday Checking, Interest Checking, Premier Checking and Private Client Checking, each at 25.00. Access Checking and Student Checking carry 0.00, so a closure inside their 90-day window costs the owner nothing.
